summary: Iteration 5 (Reels controls, Categories CRUD, Industrial Areas hierarchical CRUD, Plans CRUD + assign, Requirements public feed + Unlock flow, Admin Analytics + Users, BackButton everywhere, /post-enquiry rewrite, /requirements page) tested on mobile 420x900. Backend: 16/16 NEW iter5 tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py after fixing one critical regression (see RCA). Combined with iter4 + iip_api: 47/49 pass (2 unrelated/carry-over). Frontend: /requirements (55 req-cards, 23 unlock buttons, masked mobile, state/city/area picker, BackButton, category dropdown) all render correctly. /post-enquiry has BackButton + product + quantity fields. Admin dashboard shows all 6 spec'd tabs (Overview, Plans, Categories, Areas, Companies, Users). 2 frontend spec deviations confirmed: (a) HomePage MISSING the 'Live Buyer Feed' CTA card data-testid='home-requirements-cta' between Jobs and category chips — code has no occurrence of 'home-requirements-cta' or 'Buyer Feed' string; (b) AdminPage imports BackButton but never renders it — [data-testid='back-btn'] not in /admin DOM.

critical.issue: Returned 500 for every request. server.py L808-823 doc dict did not include product_name/quantity/state/city/industrial_area, but EnquiryOut.model_fields includes them — line 824 did doc[k] -> KeyError: 'product_name'. Broke the entire buyer→manufacturer lead flow + iter4 regressions. Testing agent patched: (1) added the 5 fields to doc, (2) changed doc[k] -> doc.get(k).

minor.issue: UserPublic does not expose plan_name / plan_id / plan_expires_at — admin UI cannot show user's current plan in the Users tab. Add these fields to UserPublic or expose a separate admin schema.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing 'Live Buyer Feed' CTA card with data-testid='home-requirements-cta' between Jobs section and category chips. Spec required. grep on HomePage.jsx finds no occurrence of 'home-requirements-cta', 'Buyer Feed', or 'Live Buyer'.
imports BackButton (L7) but never renders it. /admin page has NO back-btn in DOM. Spec required BackButton on every secondary page including /admin.
React 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning x6 in console on Home. Auto-scroll clones items without unique key suffix.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1652 lines — strongly recommend splitting into modules (auth.py, companies.py, products.py, enquiries.py, requirements.py, admin.py, categories_areas.py, plans.py, cloudinary.py). >700 line guideline already violated by 2x.

create_enquiry: 'doc' dict construction MUST mirror EnquiryOut.model_fields. The bug (now fixed) shows the fragility of using model_fields.keys() against a manually-built dict. Recommend using payload.model_dump() and merging in server-side fields (id, status, created_at) — single source of truth.

unlock_requirement: 'plan in ("free", "", None)' — None can never be in this tuple after .lower() coercion. Harmless but misleading. Also, the check uses plan_name string equality; consider using plan_id reference or a 'is_paid' boolean attribute on user to be currency/locale safe.

_can_see_contact + unlock_requirement use 'plan_name not in ("free", "")' — case-sensitive. The seed stores 'Free' (capital F), then user.get('plan_name').lower() handles it. But future plans like 'free trial' would accidentally unlock. Use a paid_plan boolean.
admin_analytics: includes 'product_engagement' aliased to post likes — naming bug. Variable is 'product_engagement' but returned key is 'post_engagement'. Functionally OK but confusing.
AdminPage.jsx imports BackButton but never renders it — dead import. Either remove or render.
/api/requirements does NOT exclude 'mobile' from the document fetch — entire mobile is loaded into memory even for masked users. Minor perf concern; consider projection in find().
UserPublic schema needs to expose plan_name for the Admin > Users tab to actually show user plans.

rca of the issue: BACKEND CRITICAL REGRESSION (now fixed by testing agent): EnquiryCreate gained 5 new Optional fields (product_name, quantity, state, city, industrial_area) and EnquiryOut mirrored them. But create_enquiry (server.py L808-823) was NOT updated — the manually-built 'doc' dict still only had the original 7 keys. Then L824 built response via dict comprehension {k: doc[k] for k in EnquiryOut.model_fields.keys()} — every iter5 EnquiryOut field caused KeyError on the very first missing key 'product_name'. FastAPI surfaced this as 500 Internal Server Error. Reproduced via: curl -X POST /api/enquiries -d '{minimal payload}' -> 500. Fix: added the 5 fields to doc using payload.* attribute access, and switched doc[k] to doc.get(k) for resilience. Verified by re-running all 49 backend tests — 47 pass (the 2 remaining failures are unrelated carry-overs documented above). FRONTEND: 'home-requirements-cta' element was never added to HomePage.jsx; AdminPage.jsx imports BackButton but the JSX tree does not include <BackButton/> anywhere — both are simple omissions in the implementation.
